components.gap: Misattribution on the route: body w02-p02-040 lines 162-164 says the source derives the non-definability of the same-type predecessor 'because Axiom 8 below is independent', while Church 1940 §2 p.59 says it follows from 'the independence of the axiom of infinity (§4)', and §4 p.61 says Axioms 7 and 8 together have that effect. The w02-p02-041 warning def:p02-w02-p02-041-church-predecessor (lines 617-628) gives the correct reading ('not on Axiom 8 alone') but neither retracts nor flags the contradicting 040 sentence, so the reader meets two inconsistent attributions of the same source remark. Correct 040:162-164 (or have 041 explicitly supersede it).
components.note: Otherwise complete: type symbols, primitive symbols, wffs, all abbreviations incl. Q, numerals, S, N, omega, pairs, P, T; bracket/dot conventions with the source's worked examples (041); rules I-VI and IV', VI'; axioms 1-11; variants; proof on assumptions; roles of axioms, n.8, extensionality remarks, defined selection schema; theorems VII, VIII, 12-43; n.10, n.12, n.13; formal vs syntactical theorems; language boundaries. The interpretation paragraph contains the misattribution above.

Every source-asserted or left-to-reader derivation is written: tautology completeness from 1-4, deduction theorem, 12-21, comprehension, 22-24 and VIII, 25-29, 26/30 at iota-types, 31-35, 36-43, recursion equations under (H) with countermodel, Rosser equations, 9 from 11, defined selection constants and independence of 9, soundness/consistency in ZFC with AC for c_alpha, independence of 7 and 8, non-theoremhood of 26 at o-types and of 30^o. Unproved source claims (n.12, predecessor non-definability) are explicitly recorded as reported, not proved.
